Why the lease expires

A lease that never expires is not a lease, it is a lock. The difference matters when the holder dies without telling anyone.

Advertisement — managed queues for teams

Renewal

A worker renews its lease while it makes progress. If the renewal fails twice in a row the worker stops writing and lets the shard return to the queue.

The queue therefore needs one operation, renew, and one failure mode, expiry. Nothing else has to be agreed between the workers.
